XLSX spreadsheet extraction using extract

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx\"}", "{}")
print(result)
```
